name: competitors
title: Competitors
purpose: Master data for competitors (Porter 1980): one competitors/<id>.json each, the person's record, and competitors/<id>/signals.json beside it, what signals say, written only by the signal projector. It needs no paid library: its signal types and listeners are open and its own, and a library such as Mentura's only feeds it more signals of the same types (Torian, 2026-11-07). Never complete. Gated by freshness.

listeners.note: A well-rated report about a company starts its master record, once, when it is missing; a person then owns it. It hears the org part of every competitor-funding and product-launch signal. A venture that reads a whole-market library and wants only the competitors it names turns it off with listeners_off in naive.config.json.

predicates.why: Only companies a person or a signal already made a competitor

listeners.note: Records what the market did: each round once, with first_seen and last_seen.

predicates.why: A round by a company the venture competes with

listeners.note: Bears on when to raise and how to position, so it proposes a decision (rival-raised-<id>) for a person, and only for news under two weeks old.

predicates.why: A launch by a company the venture competes with

listeners.note: A launch may change how the venture stands toward the competitor, so it marks the person's master record stale for them to review. The type's max_age (60 days) applies.
